notes: PURPOSE (vegetable slate #2, 2026-08-31): the insoluble-fiber bulk ingredient - ~31 kcal/100 g, weight-management filler for indoor cats; complements zucchini (moisture) and pumpkin/butternut (soluble fiber).
PREP NOTE for recipes: raw green beans carry low-level phytohaemagglutinin (far below dried beans); customer guidance should be lightly steamed even in raw recipes.
